purpose: One record per decisive factual claim that drove a hard-gate determination in the 2026-08 market screen. Not an exhaustive transcript of every sentence in every research pass (see mandate section 67: no megabytes of copied vendor pages) - these are the load-bearing facts an auditor would need to verify each PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/CONDITIONAL outcome without re-doing the research.

classification_taxonomy.OFFICIAL_VENDOR_FACT: Sourced from the vendor's own current official documentation, ideally with a verbatim quote and URL.
classification_taxonomy.DERIVED: A conclusion computed/reasoned from other recorded evidence (e.g. a utilization percentage computed from a published storage limit).
classification_taxonomy.INFERENCE: A reasonable but not directly-verified judgment, labeled as such.
classification_taxonomy.NOT_EXECUTED: Explicitly not checked/confirmed - an honest gap, not hidden.
classification_taxonomy.ANECDOTAL: A single unverified community report, used only for context, never as proof of current behavior.

records.claim: "Idle indexes cost nothing."

The only documented automatic data-deletion triggers are user-initiated deletion (soft-deleted, retained up to 90 days), non-payment account deactivation (data retained 30 days), and full account/service closure. Inactivity is not among them.
Serverless storage up to 2GB; current corpus (~63MB raw) is ~3.2% utilization at 1x, ~9.5% at 3x growth.
Exceeding egress (1GB/mo) blocks in-scope reads with a RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (429) error and an upgrade prompt - fails closed, not automatic billing.

Dense serverless indexes support cosine, euclidean, and dotproduct distance metrics with 'no restrictions on metric choices for dense vector indexes on any plan tier' - cosine confirmed available on Starter.
records.note: Resolved via direct WebFetch after the dispatched follow-up agent that was assigned this question failed on a session limit.

records.claim: Dense vector API has no preview/alpha marker anywhere and sits in the standard quarterly-stable API versioning channel (current 2026-04) - GA/Stable by strong inference, not a literal vendor 'this is GA' statement.

Document-schema/integrated full-text BM25 API is explicitly 'in [public preview]... APIs may continue to evolve before general availability,' uses API version 2026-01.alpha, and has no Node/TypeScript SDK support (Python-only).
records.note: Not a hard dependency for the shortlisted P2-style architecture (Pinecone dense + Convex lexical), which never calls this API.

records.claim: Whether a credit card is required to sign up could not be confirmed from an official source either way.
records.confidence: LOW (informational only, not a hard gate)

records.claim: 'Free tier never expires,' no credit card required to sign up.
Compute 'scales to zero after an inactive period of 5 minutes' and reactivates automatically on the next query within 'a few hundred milliseconds' - fully automatic, no manual action ever.
Branch archiving after 14 days idle is likewise fully automatic to reverse: 'No action is required to unarchive a branch... will automatically trigger the unarchive process.'
0.5GB storage limit; both HNSW and IVFFlat pgvector index types available on every plan including free, no add-on required.

Estimated vector+index storage at 1x scale is ~160-190MB (32-38% of 500MB) using a community-sourced HNSW overhead multiplier of ~1.5-2x raw vector bytes (not a single authoritative Neon-published figure); at 2x growth, estimated 350-420MB (68-82%, crossing the 80% flag in the higher-overhead case); at 3x, estimated 500-620MB, likely exceeding the 500MB cap.
records.classification: DERIVED (from a community heuristic, not an authoritative formula)
records.source: general pgvector community/vendor guidance, not a single Neon-published number
records.note: A follow-up attempt to find a more precise, authoritative figure failed on a session limit before its finding could be captured. Growth headroom remains genuinely unresolved pending real measurement.

records.claim: Storage operations that increase data capacity 'will fail until you free up space or upgrade'; compute overage suspends the project until the next billing period or an upgrade - fails closed, no card on file means no silent billing.
@neondatabase/serverless reached GA at v1.0.0 (requires Node >=19), purpose-built for serverless/edge, uses HTTPS or WebSockets instead of raw TCP.
Native tsvector/GIN full-text search is core PostgreSQL functionality, not a bolt-on extension - GA by definition, no beta labeling applicable.
records.source: PostgreSQL core documentation (general knowledge, not independently re-verified this pass)

records.claim: Free tier changed from a time-boxed 14-day trial to a genuinely permanent tier on 2026-06-17: 'free to start without a credit card or time expiration... that shift from "free until the clock runs out" to "free as long as it's useful to you."'
'Free clusters are free forever. You do not need a billing account to create a free cluster.'
100,000 objects / 1GB memory / 10GB disk / 1 collection free tier limits; 20,652-vector corpus = 20.7% utilization at 1x, 41.3% at 2x, 62% at 3x.

The dedicated Cloud FAQ (with named 'Account Management' and 'Instance Management' sections) is silent on any usage-based cluster suspension/pause/archive/deletion policy - this addresses calendar-based trial expiry (now resolved favorably), NOT usage-based dormancy suspension, which is a distinct, unanswered question.
records.classification: NOT_EXECUTED (usage-based suspension policy specifically) - downgraded from an earlier over-generous PASS reading
records.note: A targeted follow-up to resolve this specifically (checking ToS/legal pages, community forum precedent) failed on a session usage limit before completing. It found only an October 2024 staff forum post describing the OLD pre-June-2026 trial model (warning emails, extendable trial), explicitly not evidence of current behavior. Two direct attempts to fetch Weaviate's own ToS (weaviate.io/legal/terms-of-service, weaviate.io/legal) both returned HTTP 404, and this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200 used) before the correct URL could be located. Gate 3 remains UNKNOWN.

records.claim: Official v3 TypeScript client (weaviate-client) hard-requires gRPC (Node's http2 module); confirmed broken in http2-less runtimes via an OPEN, unresolved official GitHub issue (weaviate/typescript-client#145: 'fails to bundle on Cloudflare Workers due to http2 dependency'). A plain REST API exists as a fallback.
records.confidence: HIGH (issue exists and is open) / UNKNOWN (whether this actually affects Convex's specific Node action runtime - not yet tested hands-on)

records.claim: Vector indexing can be asynchronous relative to writes, but Weaviate falls back to brute-force search over up to 100,000 un-indexed objects - larger than this project's entire 20,652-chunk corpus, so no real invisible-write window at this project's scale even during indexing lag.
records.source: Weaviate documentation on async vector indexing and query fallback behavior (v1.28+)

records.claim: Native BM25(F) keyword search and native hybrid search (parallel vector + BM25, configurable fusion, default relativeScoreFusion since v1.24) - long-standing, core, no preview/beta labeling found.
Markets 'stays free forever' under quota, no credit card required.
records.confidence: MEDIUM (marketing claim, cross-checked against ToS below)

records.claim: Terms of Service (Sections 13.1/13.2, entity 'Functional Systems Inc.') lists account termination/suspension triggers as ONLY uncured material breach (30-day cure window), insolvency, cessation of operations, past-due fees, or security risk - no inactivity/no-traffic trigger in either clause.
records.confidence: HIGH - a real, legally-backed absence of a dormancy trigger, not just marketing

records.claim: Documentation examples specifically use 768-dimension vectors.
The live Quickstart page currently states, present tense: 'LambdaDB Cloud is in public preview.'
records.source: LambdaDB Quickstart documentation (live page, current as of research)
records.note: This single fact is sufficient on its own to classify LambdaDB CONDITIONAL - the whole product carries a preview label, a more severe maturity concern than TiDB's single-feature preview label on an otherwise-GA database. Gates 5-10 (distance metrics, ID model, filtering, lexical maturity, consistency model, concurrency mechanism, runtime/SDK details) were not researched before the assigned follow-up agent failed on a session limit.

records.claim: 'Always-free monthly quota for up to five TiDB Cloud Starter instances per organization' - no trial period, no credit card for the first 5 instances.

records.claim: No account-level auto-suspend found; only an automatic, transparent per-vector-index 'cold' reload after several hours of no queries (index-scoped, not account-scoped) - same favorable category as Neon's scale-to-zero.
Free tier includes 5,000,000 'stored vector dimensions' (billing unit = vector_count x dims); this project's corpus is 20,652 x 768 = 15,860,736 stored dimensions = 317% of the free allowance.

Raises the included quota to 10,000,000 stored dimensions; even at 3x corpus growth (~47.6M dimensions), overage beyond the included quota is only ~$0.02/month at the published rate of $0.05 per 100M stored dimensions.

No documented inactivity/pause/suspend/archive policy found in any current lifecycle-relevant page; architecturally a serverless, usage-metered API layer with no dedicated always-on cluster to idle-suspend the way a provisioned instance would.

records.source: Cloudflare Vectorize documentation set (pricing, limits, intro, API reference)

records.claim: Vector-only, no BM25/keyword search capability of any kind. Distance metrics available: euclidean, cosine, dot product.
